meta.name: database-migrations
meta.description: Database migration best practices for schema changes, data migrations, rollbacks, and zero-downtime deployments across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and common ORMs (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, TypeORM, golang-migrate). Use when planning or implementing database schema changes.

copy.tagline: 安全迁移数据库表结构与数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在生产环境安全地修改数据库结构。
copy.tagline_en: Safely migrate database schemas and data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to safely modify database schemas in production.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会指导你安全地修改数据库结构，包括添加字段、创建索引、迁移数据，并支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 及 Prisma、Django 等 ORM。
howto.when: 当你计划或实施数据库表结构变更、数据迁移、回滚或零停机部署时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 users 表加一个 avatar_url 字段，要安全无锁。
用 Prisma 创建一个迁移，添加 email 索引。
如何零停机重命名 users 表的 username 列？
say.note: Claude 会解释 expand-contract 模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through safe database schema changes, including adding columns, creating indexes, data migrations, and supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, and ORMs like Prisma and Django.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you plan or implement database schema changes, data migrations, rollbacks, or zero-downtime deployments.

say_en.text: Help me add an avatar_url column to the users table safely.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a PostgreSQL ALTER TABLE example.

say_en.text: Create a Prisma migration to add an email index.
say_en.note: Claude will provide Prisma commands and custom SQL.

say_en.text: How to rename the username column in users table with zero downtime?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the expand-contract pattern.
